name: Hornero Device Battery
description: Charge of the wireless things on your desk: game controllers, mice, keyboards, headsets, pens and phones, from UPower. Honest about devices that report no percentage.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Use Theme.palette.inkMuted instead of inkFaint on readable text for Signal contrast
Gate refresh and one-shot timers on visible/active state.
Initial release: wireless peripheral batteries (controllers, mice, keyboards, headsets, pens, phones) from UPower, as a dashboard card and a desktop widget.

lowPercent.description: At or below this charge a discharging device is marked LOW.

includeInternal.description: Also list the laptop battery and UPS units (the native battery indicator already covers the laptop).

showModel.description: Show the device model name under its kind.

sortBy.description: Lowest charge first, or grouped by kind of device.
